against preferred direction: against preferred direction (cost of routing perpendicular to a layer's preferred direction)
air line: air line (implementation name for an incomplete-connection record; UI: air wire)
annular ring: annular ring (copper remaining around a drilled hole)
attach smd: attach smd (allow vias or traces to attach at the center of SMD pads)
autoroute: autoroute (verb: run automatic routing; distinct from the Autorouter)
autorouter: autorouter (batch engine that routes nets with traces and vias)
bend cost: bend cost (penalty when a trace changes direction on a layer)
board outline: board outline (PCB edge boundary; routed copper stays inside)
clearance: clearance (minimum allowed distance between copper or mechanical features)
clearance class: clearance class (named spacing-rule group for traces, vias, and areas)
clearance matrix: clearance matrix (spacing table between item classes on a layer)
clearance violation: clearance violation (design-rule failure: items closer than allowed; value is shortfall)
component: component (placed footprint instance on the board)
component keepout: component keepout (zone where components must not be placed; Specctra: place keepout)
conduction area: conduction area (copper pour or plane tied to one net; Freerouting term)
copper pour: copper pour (filled copper for a net; KiCad name, Freerouting conduction area)
copper-to-edge clearance: copper-to-edge clearance (minimum distance from copper to the board outline)
courtyard: courtyard (component placement clearance boundary, not a routing keepout)
DRC: DRC / design-rule check (verification of clearances, widths, and fabrication rules)
DSN: DSN file (Specctra design file exchanged with KiCad, Autodesk Fusion, etc.)
expansion cost: expansion cost (internal maze-router cost ranking candidate path expansions)
fab: fab layer (fabrication drawing: component body outline)
fanout: fanout (short escape traces and vias from dense pads, e.g. BGA)
footprint: footprint (component land pattern on the board; Specctra package)
FRB: FRB file (Freerouting internal board snapshot; keep the name FRB)
gate: gate (Specctra logical pin group within a component)
gate pin: gate pin (Specctra pin referenced through a gate)
ground plane: ground plane (copper pour or plane used for ground)
hole: hole (drilled opening in the board, plated or unplated)
incomplete: incomplete (an incomplete connection that still needs routing)
incompletes: incompletes / incomplete connections (ratsnest air wires still open)
jump wire: jump wire (physical wire or single-sided routing substitute; distinct from jumper layer)
keepout: keepout (zone where traces, vias, or placement are forbidden)
layer: layer (copper, mask, silkscreen, or documentation plane)
length violation: length violation (routed length outside the allowed minimum or maximum)
logical part: logical part (Specctra component definition before placement)
microvia: microvia (small laser-drilled via spanning only adjacent layers)
neckdown: neckdown (automatic trace-width reduction at a narrower pad)
net: net (named electrical network of terminals: pins, vias, conduction areas)
net class: net class (shared routing rules: width, via rule, clearance)
netlist: netlist (list of nets and pin connections defining connectivity)
obstacle area: obstacle area (copper or mechanical area that blocks routing)
optimizer: optimizer (optimization-stage engine that shortens and cleans existing traces)
pad: pad (copper land where a pin or via connects)
padstack: padstack (pad and drill pattern for a pin or via on each layer)
pass: pass (one full autorouter iteration; also start pass and maximum passes)
pin: pin (component terminal to be connected by copper)
pin swap: pin swap (exchange equivalent pins or gates to improve routing)
place keepout: place keepout (Specctra grammar name for component keepout; do not use in UI)
plated hole: plated hole (metallized hole connecting layers; not automatically a signal via)
plane via costs: plane via costs (via cost when connecting to a power or ground plane)
power plane: power plane (copper pour used for power or ground)
preferred direction: preferred direction (horizontal or vertical routing bias per layer)
preferred-direction cost: preferred-direction cost (layer cost of routing in the preferred direction)
pull tight: pull tight (straighten and optimize existing trace geometry)
push and shove: push-and-shove (interactive routing that displaces existing traces)
ratsnest: ratsnest / air wires (lines showing incomplete connections between connectable items)
reference designator: reference designator (component identifier such as R1 or U3)
rip-up start costs: rip-up start costs (starting penalty for removing traces to reroute)
ripup: rip-up (remove trace segments so a net can be rerouted)
rules file: rules file / .rules (design-rules file saved separately from the board)
score: score (composite quality metric: incomplete connections, clearance violations, bends, length, vias)
SES: SES file (Specctra session file for importing routing into host CAD; distinct from .scr)
shove: shove (displace an existing trace during interactive routing)
shove fixed: shove fixed (traces/vias cannot be displaced by push-and-shove or pulled tight)
signal layer: signal layer (copper layer used for trace routing, not plane-only)
SMD: SMD (surface-mount device pad/pin; not a through-hole pin)
solder mask: solder mask (insulating coating that leaves pads exposed)
Specctra: Specctra (Specctra DSN-compatible interchange format, also used by Electra and KiCad)
stitch mode: stitch mode (routing mode for shove-fixed nets that must stay in place)
stitching: stitching (interactive routing by clicking corners manually)
stitching via: stitching via (via tying a pour or plane to a net, not a signal layer change)
system fixed: system fixed (item locked by the system; user cannot move or delete it)
teardrop: teardrop (copper fillet widening a trace into a pad or via)
terminal item: terminal item (connectable item that ends a routed group: pin, area, or terminal via)
thermal relief: thermal relief (spoke connection from a pad to a plane for soldering heat)
trace: trace (copper conductor on one layer; KiCad alias: track)
trace costs: trace costs (per-layer expansion-cost modifiers for routing on that layer)
trace length: trace length (routed length of a copper segment)
trace width: trace width (copper width of a trace)
unfixed: unfixed (item not locked; may be moved, shoved, or deleted)
unroute: unroute (remove finished routing from items or nets)
unrouted: unrouted (adjective: not yet connected by finished copper)
user fixed: user fixed (item locked by the user so it cannot be moved or shoved)
via: via (plated hole connecting copper on two or more layers)
via costs: via costs (penalty for a layer-change via; higher keeps the router on-layer)
via keepout: via keepout (zone where vias are forbidden)
via rule: via rule (allowed via padstacks and layer spans for a net class)
